principle.anti_reinvention_rule: Before CYNIC implements an agent runtime capability, verify whether Hermes already provides it and prefer an adapter unless sovereignty, security, policy, or local runtime constraints prove a gap.
principle.authority_boundary: Hermes executes. CYNIC owns coordination, policy, memory ledger, gates, evidence, task routing, and cashflow metrics.

capability_map.gap: Execution now emits bloodstream events, but completed outputs still need per-domain structured schemas for prospecting, delivery, CRM, and reporting.
CYNIC uses Hermes kanban as execution substrate but does not yet mirror kanban task graph, blockers, comments, and handoffs into the Kernel ledger.
Need a read-only browser sourcing runner that returns official_website_url evidence arrays directly to organ-prospect.
CYNIC should stop building independent research logic beyond sovereignty wrappers; route web research through Hermes-compatible local provider policies.
No canonical bridge between Hermes skills and CYNIC organ skills. Need import/export/curation policy so cashflow workflows become reusable skills.
Hermes memory must not replace Kernel memory, but useful summaries, decisions, and learned outreach patterns need a bridge into CYNIC observations.
CYNIC has many systemd/timer surfaces. Decide when Hermes cron owns business workflow cadence versus systemd owning infrastructure cadence.
Outreach cannot be fully automated yet. Need human-gated messaging adapter that drafts, queues, records approval, sends, and logs replies.
CYNIC delegates through Kernel tasks but does not yet let Hermes spawn bounded subagents whose scopes are mirrored to coord claims and mempool state.
Hermes can patch files, but CYNIC must enforce claims before launch and should prefer patch artifacts/proposals for autonomous organ agents.
Need a policy bridge so CYNIC can choose Hermes provider/model routes by cost, sovereignty, latency, and task risk.
CYNIC needs a formal adapter inventory deciding which Hermes ACP/MCP/plugin surfaces are allowed, exposed, or blocked per organ.
Potentially reuse Hermes dashboard/TUI patterns instead of building another operator UI, but must preserve CYNIC kernel as source of truth.
Could convert successful cashflow workflows into training/evaluation traces once the pipeline has revenue proof.
